subject.title: [Feature Request]: Session snapshots — save and load context checkpoints (/session save|load)

question: Should OpenClaw add first-class named session snapshots now, and what first supported scope should be chosen across arbitrary save/list/load, archive restore, compaction branch/restore, prompt-cache-aware fork, and reusable templates?
rationale: Current main has adjacent primitives but no unified product/API contract, and automation should not choose restore destructiveness, retention, privacy, archive-import, or fork semantics.

options.title: Design core snapshot API first
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define a versioned contract for named checkpoints, branch/load behavior, retention, privacy, protocol, command, CLI/UI, and tests.

options.title: Narrow to resume/archive recovery
options.body: Let a smaller read-only or restore-oriented path land first while tracking named checkpoint save/load and deterministic fork semantics separately.

options.title: Defer named snapshots
options.body: Keep compaction checkpoints, export commands, and session spawn/fork primitives separate until stronger maintainer demand justifies a unified snapshot surface.

recommendation.title: Design core snapshot API first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define a versioned contract for named checkpoints, branch/load behavior, retention, privacy, protocol, command, CLI/UI, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest prior product-review signal on this issue and recent session-area history.
